findings.problem: The explicitly independent reconstruction block prints target blocks 니/무 in its EN/DE instructions and each answer beside I1/I2. Only models are to be covered. This cannot support no-model reconstruction as laid out.
findings.proposal:
Replace the subsection's independent task with: '### 혼자 조립하기 — 학습자 문제
앞의 시범·소리 선택과 뒤의 답·상자 활동을 가리고 아래 두 줄만 보세요. 각 조각을 한 음절로 모으세요. / Cover the earlier examples and sound choices, and the answers and box activity below. Look only at the two rows and build one syllable block from each pair. / Decke die bisherigen Vorbilder und Lautaufgaben sowie die folgenden Lösungen und die Kistenübung ab.
